name: ecsyjs/ecsy
description: Experimental Entity Component System framework for JavaScript/TypeScript designed to be lightweight, easy to use, and engine-agnostic for web-based game development.
score_rationale: Pioneer JavaScript ECS library with 1.2k stars and MIT license, but archived in April 2025 after the ecosystem moved toward more performant alternatives like bitECS.
summary: Pioneering JavaScript ECS framework archived in 2025 after ecosystem shift
